Media enquiries

For journalists with media enquiries only.

Contact our Media Team:

  • Call 0800 712 315
  • Email media@ot.govt.nz

For all other enquiries go to:

Contact us

Media Privacy Consent form

We require journalists to get permission from an individual before we can talk about their case. Use the following form to do this:

Download the Privacy Consent form [WORD, 77 KB]

Where the request relates to a couple, it is advisable to get a waiver from each person.

Published: May 11, 2017
